export declare const DOCKER_HOST_PROTOCOL = 1;
export declare const DOCKER_HOST_PROTOCOL_HEADER = "x-armada-docker-host-protocol";

import type { DockerHostVersionOffer, DockerJobFailureReason } from "./docker-api.ts";
import type { DockerHostJob } from "./docker-host-job.ts";
import type { DockerHostResources, DockerSandboxLimits } from "./docker-resource-policy.ts";
import type { SnapshotBaselineTool } from "./snapshot-baseline.ts";
export interface DockerHostPollRequest {
    installationId: string;
    version: string;
    resumeClaimProtocol: 1;
    resources: DockerHostResources;
    resourcePolicyVersion: 1;
    retentionSeconds: number;
    nextCleanupAt: string | null;
    deadlines: {
        sandboxId: string;
        generation: string;
        deadline: string;
    }[];
    diskFreeBytes?: number | null;
    stoppedSandboxBytes?: number | null;
    skipSnapshots?: true;
    waitSeconds?: number;
    running?: string[];
}
export interface DockerHostPollResponse extends DockerHostVersionOffer {
    job: DockerHostJob | null;
    containerInventory?: 1;
    containerInventoryDeploymentId?: string;
    held?: true;
    limits?: DockerSandboxLimits;
    retentionSeconds?: number;
    pendingStarts?: {
        sandboxId: string;
        generation: string;
    }[];
    resumeClaims?: {
        requestId: string;
        sandboxId: string;
        generation: string;
    }[];
}
export type DockerHostResultRequest = {
    installationId: string;
    requestId: string;
    imageId?: string;
} & ({
    claimed: boolean;
} | {
    cleaned: true;
    cleanupReason?: "retention_elapsed" | "disk_pressure";
} | {
    expired: true;
} | {
    outcome: "completed" | "failed";
    reason?: DockerJobFailureReason;
    baselineVersion?: number;
    baselineTool?: SnapshotBaselineTool;
    missingRefIndex?: number;
});

import { type DockerSnapshotBinding } from "./docker-image.ts";
import type { DockerMachineRequest } from "./docker-machine.ts";
import { type GoldenConfig } from "./golden-config.ts";
export type BootstrapDescriptor = {
    serverUrl: string;
    artifact: {
        sha256: string;
        bytes: number;
    };
    enrolmentToken: string;
};
export type DockerSnapshotBuildDescriptor = DockerSnapshotBinding & {
    config: GoldenConfig;
    token: string;
    armadaVersion: string;
};
export type DockerHostJob = {
    requestId: string;
    request: DockerMachineRequest;
} & ({
    operation: "create" | "stop" | "delete";
} | {
    operation: "bootstrap" | "resume";
    bootstrap: BootstrapDescriptor;
} | {
    operation: "buildSnapshot";
    build: DockerSnapshotBuildDescriptor;
});
export declare function parseDockerHostJob(value: unknown): DockerHostJob;
export declare function canonicalDockerHostJob(value: unknown): string;

export interface DockerMachineRequest {
    sandboxId: string;
    generation: string;
    image: string;
    ttlSeconds: number;
    expiresAt?: number;
    snapshot?: DockerSnapshotBinding;
}

export interface DockerSnapshotBinding {
    id: string;
    ownerId: string;
    visibility: "private" | "org";
}

export type DockerHostResources = {
    cpus: number;
    memoryBytes: number;
    availableCpus?: number;
    availableMemoryBytes?: number;
};
export type DockerSandboxLimits = {
    cpus: number;
    memoryBytes: number;
    pids: number;
};

export interface GoldenRepo<Branch extends string | undefined = string> {
    url: string;
    branch: Branch;
    dir: string;
    history?: "full" | "shallow";
}
export interface GoldenConfig<Branch extends string | undefined = string> {
    repos: GoldenRepo<Branch>[];
    init: string[];
}

export interface DockerHostVersionOffer {
    targetVersion?: string;
}
export declare const DOCKER_JOB_FAILURE_REASONS: readonly ["image_unavailable", "snapshot_build_failed", "disk_full"];
export type DockerJobFailureReason = (typeof DOCKER_JOB_FAILURE_REASONS)[number];

declare const checks: {
    python3: string;
    "python3-venv": string;
    "python3-pip": string;
    node: string;
    npm: string;
    bun: string;
    git: string;
    gh: string;
    "build-essential": string;
    curl: string;
    unzip: string;
    jq: string;
    ripgrep: string;
    "ca-certificates": string;
    "openssh-client": string;
    "util-linux": string;
};
export type SnapshotBaselineTool = keyof typeof checks;
export {};
